headline: SK Group Data Center Division Explores Capital for $350 Billion AI Buildout
summary: The data center subsidiary of South Korea's SK Group is seeking financing to support an estimated $350 billion artificial intelligence infrastructure deployment.
why: SK Group is South Korea's second-largest conglomerate and controls memory-chip powerhouse SK Hynix, placing it at the heart of global AI semiconductor and infrastructure supply chains.

impacts.name: SK Hynix Inc
impacts.why: Large-scale AI data center buildouts boost structural demand for high-bandwidth memory chips.
